items.text: New England G Alijah Vera-Tucker (hamstring) is on IR (not season-ending). Mike Vrabel reported no major new injuries from Week 7; C Ben Brown (knee) is back practicing and S Kevin Byard played 94% of snaps.

Miami RB Jaylen Wright (quad) left Week 7 and did not return (Ollie Gordon takes over); De'Von Achane is out for the season. S Dante Trader Jr. (shoulder) was hurt in the win over the Jets. Malik Willis starts.
